mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.5% signals labor market deterioration, triggering reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 35% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05 in 3-year rolling regression.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), rising FEDFUNDS signals aggressive tightening, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS rises, or interaction term p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances when HOUST rises, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) falling below 50,000 jobs/month signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer confidence and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS < 50000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining retail sales (RSAFS) combined with rising FEDFUNDS indicates consumer spending contraction amid monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with weak consumer demand
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 35% of instances when RSAFS declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05 in 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO < 100), further industrial production declines signal economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.
